content.what_it_is: A collection of initial/boundary wave generators: SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY (L56-L83), an edit-by-GOTO INITIAL_WAVE sample (L95-L160), rectangular/Gaussian/dipole humps (L173-L427), N-wave and solitary-wave fields (L439-L571), and SUB_SLTRY's Newton solution for solitary coefficients (L582-L634). Cartesian/spherical and serial/parallel coordinate branches are selected by preprocessing.
entities: SUBROUTINE SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY at L56; locals aa,h00,c1,tex,tlag,zz and Iwavemaker at L59-L60
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_WAVE at L95; arrays XX,YY and locals sigma,x_c,y_c,a,r,ii1,ii2 at L98-L100
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_RECTANGULAR at L173/L175 with intent declarations L184-L191
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_GAUSIAN at L258/L260 with intent/local declarations L269-L277
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_DIPOLE at L347/L349 with intent/local declarations L358-L366
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_N_WAVE at L439 with arguments/intents L446-L454
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE at L511 with arguments/intents/locals L519-L529
SUBROUTINE SUB_SLTRY at L582 with inputs/outputs/locals L585-L588

params_defined.name: alp
params_defined.range: SUB_SLTRY dispersion coefficient input; not checked

equations.ref: Gaussian hump; repeated across coordinate branches

calls: STOP at L457 for dep==ZERO and L612 after Newton iteration limit

verbatim_spans.text: ! something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39

unresolved: Control-flow neutralizes INITIAL_WAVE: GOTO 200 at L123 skips the box assignment L125-L131; GOTO 100 at L135 skips the dam-break assignment L137-L141; GOTO 213 at L150 skips the alongshore crest L151-L157. Thus the callable subroutine returns without assigning Eta in any of its three sample blocks.

Serial INITIAL_RECTANGULAR computes Il/Ir/Jl/Jr at L231-L239 and directly assigns Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr) at L242 without the overlap test and clipping used by the parallel branch at L220-L226. Centers or widths outside the local array can form out-of-range sections only in the serial path.
WID is used as a divisor in every Gaussian/dipole branch (L292, L305, L318, L327, L381-L382, L395-L396, L409-L410, L419-L420) without a nonzero/positive check; WID=0 makes the profile singular.

INITIAL_N_WAVE checks only dep==ZERO at L455-L458, but the formulas at L463 and L493 require positive dep and a compatible Ha/dep for nested square roots. Negative depth or amplitude/depth combinations can enter invalid square roots. Arguments x2 and gamma_s in the interface L439 are never used in L439-L499.

Interface/implementation mismatch: INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE declares Beta as an input at L525, but the intended Beta relation is commented out at L531 and alpha is always overwritten with -0.39 at L534 before SUB_SLTRY L536. Caller-supplied Beta has no effect.

SUB_SLTRY divides by h1 and alp at L595 and L598-L600 without validation, and Newton's update L607 has no fpx==0 guard. The only iteration protection is STOP after ite>10 at L610-L613; invalid coefficients can divide by zero before that check.
